integrity: Exact exhaustive reconstruction of every nonempty simplex and every Hasse cover, plus full matching-acyclicity verification; no independent mathematical audit.

scientific_scope: For the Boolean four-cube only, the exact integral homotopy types of total k-cut complexes at each integer k from 4 through 8.
title: Higher total-cut complexes of the Boolean four-cube
